body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.70 (naive base rate 0.85) that: Hindustan Unilever Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥22.0% (inside its 22–24% guided band). Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Oct/Nov-2026): USG 15%, UVG 7% (price increases taken); EBITDA margin 22.6%, 'well within our guided range'; 'Commodity inflation is expected to remain elevated. We expect medium-term EBITDA Margin to be within the current guided range of 22% to 24%.' Screener OPM: Mar-25 24%, Sep-25 24%, Dec-25 23%, Mar-26 23%, Jun-26 23%, Sep-26 22% — steady downward drift. Reasoning: Cushion is only ~0.6 pt and the cost cycle (crude, palm, inflation) is adverse; HUL protects margins with price but with a lag. Shade below the 'always in band' base. Resolution: YES if HUL's Q3 FY27 (Dec-2026 quarter) consolidated EBITDA margin as reported by the company is ≥22.0%; cross-check with screener Operating Profit ÷ Sales (if they differ, the company-reported figure governs). Source: HUL Q3 FY27 results press release; screener.in consolidated quarterly. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: HUL's quarterly EBITDA margin has stayed ≥22% in essentially every quarter of the last ~3 years (~85%).
